description: A floor-length deep muted teal court dress with dense gold woven-looking floral and geometric decoration. The bodice is fitted and structured with a low square neckline; the upper chest is visible while the bust and torso remain covered by opaque fabric. Wide elbow-length sleeves have patterned cuffs. A cream woven-looking wrap rests around the lower arms and hangs along both sides. A decorated narrow belt with round metal ornaments and a hanging medallion-and-tassel chain defines the waist. The skirt is layered over a cream patterned inner panel and falls to the floor. One dark patterned boot is visible. The exact fibre composition cannot be determined from the picture.
